alertBody: Keep voices low, respect privacy when taking photos, and leave no litter or cigarette ends.

quiet: Keep voices low in residential lanes
quietBody: People rest here. Please pass quietly, especially late at night.
privacy: Leave privacy out of your photos
privacyBody: Avoid photographing inside homes, windows or residents without permission.
litterBody: Keep litter until you find a public bin. Household recycling areas are not public bins.
smokeBody: Please smoke only in the smoking booths shown on the map. A Seongsu resident we interviewed said they take a detour around their own street because of cigarette smoke. Dropping cigarette butts on the street can be fined KRW 50,000 (Wastes Control Act).
aboutIntro: A map for finding your way while respecting everyday life.
aboutBody: TOUR:TOGETHER is a student project helping visitors understand Seongsu as a living neighborhood. It connects useful places with considerate visiting habits. We count visits only, without identifying individuals, and never collect your location.
evidenceBody: Of 7 respondents, 5 were unaware of the residential character and all 7 expressed interest. This small exploratory survey does not represent all visitors or prove behavior change.
locationPrivacyBody: Location is processed on this page. We do not save your trail or send coordinates to a project server. Tile providers receive map requests; external maps receive place details. Alerts are not guaranteed while the screen is off or another app is active.
mapLanguage: Base-map labels may remain in their original language.
zoneInfo: An illustrative boundary, not an official land-use or access restriction.
mappedZoneNote: OSM land-use boundaries, not official zoning or field-surveyed limits.

mapRecordNote: Community map information. Check the address and availability before visiting.
